mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the document with a qualified notary in the country of origin, then obtain an Apostille from the designated Competent Authority if that country is an Apostille Convention state. The China side accepts the Apostille directly without consular legalization. For a non-member state, after notarization the document must be authenticated by the issuing state's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and then legalized by the Embassy/Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that state. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and mutually exclusive; do not combine both.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before filing, the compliance team must perform enhanced due diligence on each natural-person UBO with more than 25% ownership, all directors, legal representatives, supervisors, finance personnel, authorized signatories, and high-risk agents. Screen against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list and UN resolutions; China's Foreign Sanctions Law (2021) and the MOFCOM Unreliable Entity List; the PBOC counter-terrorism financing blacklist; OFAC SDN, Non-SDN, and sectoral sanctions lists where any U.S. nexus exists; the EU consolidated sanctions list and UK sanctions list where EU or UK nexus exists; and Chinese domestic court enforcement and default lists. PEP identification covers foreign politically exposed persons, domestic prominent officials, international organization prominent figures, their immediate family members, and close associates. All matches must be escalated to the AML compliance officer, documented, and unresolved hits must block incorporation and bank account opening. Continuous screening is required throughout the WFOE corporate life.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and local Market Regulation Administration enterprise name pre-approval online portal (SAMR Enterprise Name Reservation System)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE name must be in Simplified Chinese characters and must contain four components: administrative division prefix, unique trade name, industry or operational characteristics, and legal form Co., Ltd. for a limited liability entity. If the foreign investor's trade name is in a Latin script, a phonetic or semantic Chinese transliteration is required and must be consistent on the Business License. Only one Chinese name is registered; an English name may be recorded for bank, customs, and customer purposes but is not a substitute. No standalone Latin-script name is acceptable for SAMR registration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name cannot be extended; the applicant must reserve a new name or re-apply for the same name if it remains available before expiry. If the SAMR or local Market Regulation Administration issues a refusal, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration with the next higher Administration within 60 days of written notice, stating all factual and legal grounds and supplying corrected name components. If reconsideration is refused or unanswered within the statutory period, the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit before the competent People's Court within six months from the date of receiving the reconsideration decision or from expiry of the reconsideration deadline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices and commercial mailboxes are not permissible for this WFOE. The SAMR requires a fixed, verifiable registered address with lease proof or property ownership certificate. The tax authority treats distance-service or mail-forwarding addresses as no business premises and can flag the enterprise as abnormal or non-operating. Banks, under PBOC AML customer due diligence, require a physical site visit, office signage, utility usage, and evidence of actual management activity before opening corporate accounts; a virtual address will be rejected. Cold-chain pharmaceutical storage further requires a physical temperature-controlled warehouse, valid operating license, on-site responsible personnel, temperature monitoring equipment, and compliance with storage and logistics regulations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: high probability of approximately 75% within the first 12 months that the municipal market regulation authority or tax authority will conduct an unannounced physical inspection of the registered office for address verification and commercial substance; medium probability of approximately 40% that medical product administration and municipal food-and-drug authorities will inspect cold storage operations for pharmaceutical temperature-chain compliance; low-to-medium probability of approximately 15-25% that fire safety, customs, or local tax authorities will inspect unless anomalies appear. Readiness checklist: original lease, property ownership certificate, site map, temperature monitoring logs, refrigeration backup generator, calibrated thermometers, cold storage unit maintenance records, personnel workbooks, standard operating procedures for temperature excursions, copies of pharmaceutical storage permits, external signage, access control, CCTV, and proof of utility payment.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law of the People's Republic of China (adopted 1993, comprehensively revised December 29, 2023, effective July 1, 2024), Articles 4, 27, 32, 33, 35, 36, 46, 47, 59 and 60; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 6, 8, 12 and 28; Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment Access (Negative List, 2021 Edition); Regulations on the Implementation of the Foreign Investment Law; Measures for the Administration of Foreign-Invested Enterprises Registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local Municipal or District Market Supervision Administration at the proposed registered office location, with filings accepted by the enterprise registration window of the local government administrative service center or the provincial enterprise registration online integrated service platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company, together with the signed Articles of Association, the First Board Resolution, and the Foreign Investment Information Report.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed for a general WFOE engaged in cold-chain logistics warehousing. The subscribed registered capital must be paid in full within five years from the date of issuance of the business license pursuant to Article 47 of the Companies Law, unless a special industrial regulation imposes a shorter period. The contribution amount, method and schedule must be set out in the Articles of Association. No blocked escrow account or mandatory capital verification report is required for this ordinary warehousing activity; however, any capital injection from a non-resident shareholder must enter Jiangsu through a foreign exchange capital account and be reported under the SAFE foreign-invested enterprise information registration procedure. The registered capital must be sufficient for the intended scale of the cold-storage facility to satisfy the commercial board and the industrial licensing authority.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF [Company Name], WHOLF FOREIGN OWNED ENTERPRISE LIMITED BY SHARES. The undersigned, constituting the full board of directors of the Company, acting under Article [●] of the Articles of Association and Articles 59 and 60 of the Companies Law of the People's Republic of China, hereby adopt the following resolutions as the first resolutions of the board with full force and effect as at the date of the business license. 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION: RESOLVED, that the registered capital of the Company is fixed at RMB [●] divided into [●] ordinary shares with no par value; the subscription by the founding shareholder is ratified and accepted; the subscriber shall pay the registered capital in the manner and on the dates set forth in the Articles of Association, and in all cases within the five-year statutory time limit after incorporation. The General Manager is authorized to execute the contribution schedule, to collect the paid-in capital, to record each deposit in the Company's books, and to issue funding certificates against such contributions. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION: RESOLVED, that the Company shall open a basic deposit account, a general deposit account and, if needed by the capital plan, a foreign exchange capital account with a licensed commercial bank in China. The General Manager and the Chief Financial Officer are authorized to select the bank, to sign account opening documentation, to establish a two-signatory control rule for payments above RMB [●], to configure online banking, to issue banking mandates for the legal representative, and to change these mandates from time to time upon written resolution of the manager. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION: RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company is hereby fixed at [Full address of the cold-storage facility and office, City, Province, People's Republic of China] and that the General Manager is authorized to sign the lease for the registered office, to forward the lease to the market supervision registry, and to accept service of legal process, tax notices and regulatory letters at that address. 4. APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS: RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed Executive Director and General Manager of the Company and shall serve as the legal representative of the Company; [Name] is appointed Supervisor; and [Name] is appointed Chief Financial Officer. Each officer shall hold office until resignation or removal by the shareholder and shall exercise powers in accordance with the Articles of Association, the Companies Law and applicable foreign investment policies. 5. IMPLEMENTATION: RESOLVED, that all officers are severally authorized to execute all contracts, permits, filings, tax registration documents, social security registrations, bank forms, environmental licensing forms and any other instrument that the legal counsel deems necessary to implement these resolutions. This resolution may be executed in counterparts and is effective immediately upon adoption.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-approval and Foreign-Invested Business Scope Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal or District Market Supervision Administration, Enterprise Registration Division, and the SAMR online enterprise registration portal of the relevant province.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an enterprise name pre-approval application through the local administrative service center or the provincial online registration platform using three proposed legal names in Chinese characters plus a romanized transliteration. Each name must include the administrative district, a distinctive element, the industry wording such as refrigerated logistics, and the corporate suffix Company Limited. The business scope must be drafted narrowly to cover refrigerated warehousing, cold-chain distribution, pharmaceutical storage, temperature-controlled logistics and supply-chain management, with a candidate English translation attached for the record. The application must be accompanied by the apostilled or legalized certificate of incorporation of the foreign investor and a letter of authorization for the local filing agent. The applicant must self-assess the 2021 Negative List to confirm that no foreign investment restriction applies to ISIC 5210 warehousing operations, and if the business scope contains any restricted industry, the applicable pre-licensing authority must be consulted before registration. If the name is rejected or suspended because of similarity or confusion, the applicant must file a fresh name application with a stronger distinctive element or submit a letter of no objection from the conflicting prior registrant.
required_dossiers: Name pre-approval application form
Three alternative company name proposals
Foreign investor certificate of incorporation duly notarized and apostilled or legalized
Power of attorney for the filing agent
Preliminary business scope in Chinese and English
Negative List self-assessment statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is queried, examine the query notice and submit a written clarification or a revised name within three working days. If rejected, immediately submit new alternatives; no penalty is incurred. If the business scope is challenged, amend the scope and resubmit; for restricted industries, obtain the relevant departmental approval before re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Establishment Registration and Business License Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration (SAMR) at the district or municipal level where the registered office is located, and the online integrated enterprise registration platform of the provincial government.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the formal application for establishment registration of the WFOE after name pre-approval. The application must contain the signed Articles of Association, the pro-forma first board resolution, the lease contract and the owner's real property certificate for the registered office, the identity certificates of the legal representative, directors, supervisor and senior officers, and the notarized and apostilled certificates of the foreign shareholders. All statutory forms must be signed by the legal representative or by an appointed agent presenting a notarized power of attorney. The applicant must declare that the registered capital is payable within the five-year statutory period and that the business scope is not within the Negative List. The SAMR will review the enterprise registration form, the foreign investment information report, and the Articles of Association for mandatory clauses on liability, governance and liquidation. Once approved, the SAMR issues the business license carrying the unified social credit code, which constitutes conclusive evidence of legal personality. The enterprise then becomes automatically enabled for tax, statistical and social-security registration through the one-stop data-sharing system, but physical follow-up is required under the next SOP step.
required_dossiers: Signed establishment registration application form
Entire Articles of Association executed by the foreign shareholder
First Board Resolution adopted by the initial board
Lease agreement and real property ownership certificate or use-right certificate for the registered office
Notarized and apostilled foreign investor identity documents
Passport or ID copies of legal representative, directors, supervisor and managers
Name pre-approval certificate
Foreign Investment Information Report
Negative List compliance confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SAMR issues a correction notice, the applicant must provide the requested supplements or amendments within ten working days. If the application is returned, cure every identified defect and resubmit through the same portal. If a disapproved item relates to the business scope, first obtain the favorable licensing opinion from the supervising industry authority and then reapply; administrative reconsideration before the higher SAMR is available within 60 days of rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Carving and Post-Registration Tax and Social Security Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed engraving company approved by the Municipal Public Security Bureau; local Tax Service Bureau branch; local social insurance center and housing provident fund management center acting through the government service platform.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the business license, apply to a licensed seal engraving enterprise to produce the company seal, finance seal, legal representative seal, contract seal and invoice seal. The legal representative or an authorized officer must appear with the original business license and identity document; the engraving enterprise performs the mandatory public security filing. Within thirty days of incorporation, complete the initial taxation registration through the electronic tax bureau, designate the accounting method, set the taxpayer type, and register the financial officer and the tax preparer. Simultaneously, register the company and its employees with the local social insurance bureau and the housing provident fund office; payroll entries must be aligned with the employee list before the first salary run. The WFOE should also apply for the electronic tax invoice quota and complete the general taxpayer or small-scale taxpayer assessment based on projected cold-storage revenue. All corporate records required by SAMR, including the resolutions, seal-use policies, and a book of members, should be kept at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Original and photocopy of the business license with unified social credit code
Legal representative identity document
Registration application for seal carving
Appointment letters of the tax accountant and financial officer
Articles of Association
Lease agreement and certificate of registered office
Social insurance participation application and employee name list
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is delayed, file a late-filing explanation through the electronic tax bureau, pay any nominal over-due fine, and accelerate completion. If social insurance registration is queried, correct employee identity records and re-submit within five working days; arrears, if any, must be settled before the next pay period to avoid administrative warning.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Foreign Direct Investment Foreign Exchange Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A licensed commercial bank operating in China subject to People's Bank of China rules, with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) registration performed through the authorized bank under the direct administration system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the basic deposit account for the WFOE after seal carving; the basic account is mandatory for daily business settlement, salary payment and tax payment. The bank will request the business license, the unified social credit code certificate, the company seals, the legal representative identity, and the banking control resolution. Immediately after the basic account is opened, instruct the bank to complete the foreign-invested enterprise information registration with SAFE, a step that establishes the foreign exchange capital account entitlement under the Company's registration number. Once the SAFE record is returned, the Company may open the foreign exchange capital account in either the same bank or another bank, and the foreign shareholder may remit capital from its own overseas account with the remittance purpose stated as registered capital. The receiving bank will verify the amount against the Articles of Association and the SAFE filing; funds so received are placed under foreign exchange control and cannot be used for equity investments or capital market transactions without special approval. The Company must keep contribution records and exchange settlement documents and update SAFE after any material change in paid-in capital.
required_dossiers: Business license and unified social credit code certificate
Company seal, financial seal and legal representative seal
Bank control resolution or board resolution
Articles of Association
FDI Foreign Exchange Registration Form
Legal representative and financial officer identity documents
Lease agreement or address proof as required by the bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank identifies an inconsistency between the shareholding structure and the Articles, prepare a board resolution to conform such documents and reload the SAFE registration through the bank. If the bank delays because of anti-money-laundering due diligence, supply source-of-funds statements, corporate structure diagrams and any additional customer due diligence forms no later than five working days. If SAFE rejects the registration, correct the foreign investment information report and resubmit electronically without waiting for the next calendar month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Cold-Storage Operating License, Fire Safety Approval and Environmental Pre-Operation Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Administration for Market Regulation; Municipal Medical Products Administration or Drug Administration where applicable; local Fire and Rescue Service; local Ecology and Environment Bureau; and the municipal commerce department for cold-chain logistics registration where provincial cold-chain monitoring rules apply.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before accepting any inventory, the WFOE must confirm the regulated status of the goods it will store. For pharmaceutical or medical-device cold chains, apply to the Municipal Medical Products Administration for a Drug Distribution License or complete the Medical Device Operating Filing, depending on the controlled articles, and implement a compliant quality manual covering temperature mapping, calibration, validation, deviation management and recall support. If perishable food is stored, obtain a Food Operation License from the Market Supervision Administration. Simultaneously, submit the cold-storage warehouse plan to the local Fire and Rescue Service for fire-protection design filing and completion acceptance filing, including fire-suppression systems, smoke detection, emergency lighting, refrigeration plant fire hazards, and insulation materials with appropriate fire classification. For environmental compliance, complete the EIA registration or obtain an exemption letter through the Ecology and Environment Bureau online system, apply if the facility uses ammonia refrigeration above the hazard threshold, and maintain refrigerant logs. The local commerce bureau may require the company to enter the provincial cold-chain traceability platform before the first dispatch.
required_dossiers: Pharmaceutical cold-chain storage permit application or medical device filing form
Good Supply Practice or equivalent quality management manual
Temperature mapping report and calibrated digital logger certificates
Fire-protection design documents and fire acceptance filing form
Fire safety acceptance certificate or equivalent inspection receipt
EIA registration filing receipt or exemption letter
Ammonia or refrigerant safety registration if applicable
Special equipment registration forms for forklifts and pressure vessels
Emergency response plan for refrigeration failure and product recall
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an industrial permit is queried, submit the requested quality or facility corrections within five working days; if an inspection fails, obtain a targeted engineering rectification certificate and request reinspection. If fire acceptance is suspended, complete the structural and electrical rectifications and resubmit the fire-protection dossier. If the EIA registration is returned with a demand for a full environmental report, hire a licensed environment consultancy and change project classification accordingly before submitting the final report.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Administration for Market Regulation; Municipal Medical Products Administration or Drug Administration; local Fire and Rescue Service; local Ecology and Environment Bureau; and the municipal commerce or logistics department responsible for provincial cold-chain monitoring registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Drug Distribution License for pharmaceutical cold-chain storage; Food Operation License where perishable food is held; Medical Device Operating Filing where medical devices are stored; and provincial Cold-Chain Logistics Enterprise Registration for temperature-controlled warehousing operations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China (MEE) through the municipal or provincial Ecology and Environment Bureau with jurisdiction over the cold-storage facility.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: For a conventional temperature-controlled warehouse storing packaged pharmaceuticals or food and using hermetic, non-ammonia refrigeration equipment, the project normally falls under Environmental Registration (environmental impact registration filing or 备案) or is exempt if no land-use change is required. A full Environmental Impact Report Form (报告表) with quantitative risk analysis becomes mandatory if the facility uses ammonia refrigeration and the ammonia inventory crosses the major-hazard threshold, or if it stores hazardous waste, flammable liquids or dangerous chemicals. If the site is a pure distribution depot with no industrial waste discharge and no open chemical storage, the applicant should obtain a written exemption from the local ecology bureau.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Sanitary sewage connected to the municipal sewer network must meet GB/T 31962-2015 for municipal wastewater, with COD no greater than 500 mg/L, BOD5 no greater than 300 mg/L, total nitrogen no greater than 70 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen no greater than 45 mg/L, and total phosphorus no greater than 8 mg/L. There is no process wastewater expected from a cold-storage facility; cooling water blowdown must not introduce oil above 5 mg/L before discharge. Refrigeration systems charged with HFC refrigerants must be leak-tested during installation and annually thereafter, with a maximum annual leak rate of 1 percent of the declared charge; maintenance records must be kept for at least three years. If ammonia is used, the workplace eight-hour time-weighted average exposure limit is 25 parts per million and the short-term excursion limit is 35 parts per million according to GBZ 2.1; ammonia storage above 10 tonnes requires major-hazard installation filing. Waste refrigerant oil, desiccants, filter cores and contaminated containers are hazardous waste and must be stored in labeled, sealed, impermeable containers and removed by a licensed hazardous waste operator within one year using the electronic manifest system.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The WFOE must obtain Fire Protection Design Filing and Fire Protection Completion Acceptance Filing from the local Fire and Rescue Service, including approval of the cold-room insulation, fire resistance of panels, hydrant spacing, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, smoke detection, fire alarm routing and the operation of the refrigeration machine room. Where the facility is open to staff or visitors, an inspection before use for public assembly is required if applicable under local fire codes. A qualified structural engineer must certify that the slab and racking system are designed for the specified high-bay pallet loading and that the dock levellers, insulated doors and freezer partitions meet the static and live load requirements. Workplace safety clearance must include low-temperature risk assessment, ammonia or refrigerant gas detection, emergency ventilation, emergency escape plans, forklift operator licenses, registration of pressure vessels with the SAMR special-equipment authority, and a written cold-chain failure and product-quarantine procedure.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; primary online portal is the National Unified Electronic Tax Administration (e-Tax) at https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn, with the STA gateway at https://www.chinatax.gov.cn and export rebate processing through the same e-Tax system integrated with the General Administration of Customs (GACC).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE), the statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN) is the 18-character Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) automatically granted by the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) upon incorporation and printed on the Business License. There is no separate TIN application. The WFOE must complete tax registration in the e-Tax system within 30 days of the business license date, file base entity information, complete real-name authentication for the legal representative, financial officer and tax agent, and report the opening of any bank deposit account within 15 days of account opening. The same USCC is used as the VAT registration number for Chinese VAT purposes. For a foreign non-resident enterprise without a permanent establishment in China, the competent STA branch at the place where the withholding agent/payer of China-source income is located will issue a dedicated non-resident TIN upon filing of the Non-Resident Enterprise Tax Registration Declaration; the home-country tax reference number is also recorded, and the Chinese payer typically acts as statutory withholding agent for both CIT and VAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None for US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections; PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law imposes entity-level classification as a resident enterprise or non-resident enterprise. Under VAT, an enterprise may elect general taxpayer status before reaching the mandatory RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover if it has sound accounting and fixed place of business; otherwise it is a small-scale VAT taxpayer until the statutory threshold is crossed.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) administered by the State Taxation Administration; standard headline rate 13%, reduced rates 9% (transport/construction/agriculture) and 6% (services including logistics auxiliary and refrigerated warehousing).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable sales (approximately USD 700,000) for compulsory general VAT taxpayer registration; every taxable person that processes a Business License, including a WFOE, must complete VAT/tax registration immediately upon establishment with no minimum turnover exemption.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT invoices must be created through the State Taxation Administration's Golden Tax System Phase IV infrastructure using Tax Control digital devices or certified electronic-invoicing API interfaces. Special VAT invoices are transmitted to the STA at issuance in real time; the system assigns unique digital signatures, QR anti-fraud monograms and an electronic invoice number. Universal Electronic Invoices are cleared through the National Electronic Invoice Service Platform and can be authenticated on the National Invoice Inspection Platform. Enterprises must submit invoice data through e-Tax or an STA-certified API gateway, and invoice data is cross-checked against customs export declarations, export rebate filings and foreign-exchange receipt records. No paper invoice is required for export zero-rating substantiation, but the invoice and its metadata must match the customs and foreign-exchange documentation exactly.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods by a VAT general taxpayer from the PRC customs territory to a destination outside China is eligible for the 0% VAT export rate with refund of relevant input VAT (export exemption and rebate), provided the goods are not subject to export prohibition, a valid PRC Customs Export Goods Declaration is filed by the exporter, ownership of the goods passes to an overseas buyer, payment is received from the overseas buyer in foreign currency and repatriated to China in accordance with SAFE rules, and the value, quantity and product description in the customs declaration, commercial invoice and foreign-exchange receipt are consistent. For cold-chain perishable pharmaceuticals, any statutory export licensing and cold-chain logistics records must accompany the shipment. Warehousing/storage services physically performed within China (cold-room storage) are generally subject to 6% VAT because the services are consumed in China; zero-rating is limited to the export of goods and to cross-border services expressly listed in the STA cross-border VAT zero-rate announcement.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Goods Declaration (PRC Cargo Export Declaration, the exact statutory customs export form equivalent to a Bill of Entry) with the 18-digit customs declaration number and exit customs endorsement
Ocean Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing shipment from a PRC port and arrival/destination outside China
Export commercial invoice and packing list exactly matching the customs declaration value, quantity and cold-chain product specification

Export proceeds collection verification / Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) issued by a PRC-designated bank, or SAFE export-collection digital record, showing actual receipt of foreign currency from the overseas buyer
Bank foreign exchange settlement record and SAFE repatriation verification confirming the funds were surrendered/converted or lawfully retained under SAFE rules
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA, customs and SAFE may jointly perform post-clearance audits comparing the customs declaration, e-invoice records, transport and temperature-monitoring logs, insurance documents, bank statements and foreign-exchange receipts. If 0% zero-rating is unsubstantiated, the refunded VAT together with any unpaid VAT is clawed back with daily late-payment interest at 0.05% of the overdue amount; under Article 66 of the PRC Law on the Administration of Tax Collection, fraudulent export refunds are punishable by recovery of the refund plus an administrative penalty of between 100% and 500% of the amount falsely obtained. Criminal prosecution under Article 204 of the Criminal Law of the PRC for fraudulent export tax refund can lead to criminal fines plus imprisonment, with life imprisonment available for especially large amounts. Negative audit findings also trigger retrospective adjustment to the prior VAT returns, loss of subsequent zero-rating eligibility, and suspension or revocation of the Export Tax Refund Qualification.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), the foreign exchange control agency operating under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime in which RMB is convertible on the current account for trade in goods and services, but capital-account transactions remain under a registration and quota-based control system led by SAFE. A WFOE must complete Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) registration and open a Capital Account-Foreign Exchange Settlement Account at a licensed domestic bank; proceeds from registered paid-in capital are settled into RMB only after the bank verifies the SAFE filing and the underlying contractual purpose. Current-account operating flows, including rent, power, service fees, imported refrigeration equipment, and third-party logistics costs, are settled on presentation of invoices, contracts, customs declarations, and tax records. Profit and dividend remittance outside China is permissible but requires a certified annual audit, income tax filing, retained-earnings computation, and a bank administrative review for current-account repatriation; there is no unrestricted free convertibility for balance-sheet restructuring, intercompany netting, or cross-border guarantees unless separately registered. Export proceeds must be repatriated into China; while no fixed mandatory surrender percentage now exists, banks may require voluntary settlement or retention in an approved account. Any funds used outside the permitted positive list, such as RMB entrusted loans to unaffiliated parties, domestic equity investment, or non-self-use real estate, are prohibited and will trigger AML and SAFE non-compliance consequences. The policy environment therefore supports transactional convertibility, not full asset-based convertibility.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE trade monitoring and verification rules, export foreign exchange receipts must be repatriated through a designated domestic bank and declared in the Trade Foreign Exchange Monitoring System. For ordinary open-account exports, the receipt must be collected within 90 days from the export customs declaration date; any overdue unmatched item must be reported by the bank. For letter-of-credit and documentary-collection exports, the inward proceeds must be received by the payment value date plus a maximum permissible grace of 90 days from the maturity date; extensions beyond this threshold require advance SAFE registration for delayed export proceeds. Since the 2012 current-account administration reform, there is no fixed statutory conversion percentage for export receipts; the WFOE may retain up to 100% of the foreign currency in a current-account foreign exchange account or voluntarily settle up to 100% into RMB at the prevailing interbank rate. In SAFE trade-investment facilitation pilot zones, eligible low-risk enterprises may adopt automatic settlement regimes, but this is a policy-driven facilitation measure rather than a mandatory conversion ratio.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Capital Foreign Exchange Settlement Account and Basic Operational RMB Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational Currency Account and Export Proceeds Collection Account
Basic Deposit Account and Cold-Chain Trade Settlement Account
Operational RMB Account and Foreign Currency Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low - legally impracticable as the primary banking rail. Offshore fintech EMIs are not licensed as deposit-taking institutions by the National Financial Regulatory Administration or the People's Bank of China and cannot hold SAFE capital-account registration, issue tax-compliant domestic transaction records, or participate in CIPS clearing for the WFOE. Cross-border capital injection must enter through a licensed domestic tier-1 bank. An offshore EMI may be used by the overseas parent only for pre-funding in hard currency before the MT103 wire to China, but it cannot service the WFOE's balance-sheet liquidity or execute RMB clearing onshore without a Chinese banking licence.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical attendance. Under PBOC account-opening rules and NFRA KYC practice, the statutory legal representative and at least one director with more than 10% shareholding must appear in person at the chosen bank branch to sign the account-opening application, CRS/FATCA self-certifications, and corporate banking agreements. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted for a new WFOE corporate account in mainland China; a consular notarized power of attorney may support, but cannot replace, the physical interview of the legal representative. If the legal representative is a non-resident without a mainland identity document, the bank may require the local finance director or a resident officer of the WFOE to attend jointly. Some banks also conduct a site visit to the physically operated refrigerated cold-storage warehouse to verify substantive business presence before activating high-value transaction limits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity across an offshore parent holding chain, especially if any intermediate entity is in a low-tax or high-secrecy jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized UBO register and complete corporate ownership-chain chart; company registry extracts and incumbency certificates from each intermediate jurisdiction; shareholder register showing exact shareholding percentages and voting rights; source-of-wealth declaration for each ultimate beneficial owner; and, for low-tax jurisdiction intermediates, a CPA-prepared substance analysis and audited financial statements proving economic substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds mismatch on the initial cross-border capital injection, including large lump-sum remittances from a non-investor third party
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve months of consolidated bank statements for the ultimate investing entity; audited financial statements or certified distributable profits; loan agreements and credit approvals if the injection is debt-funded; signed board resolution approving the capital contribution; subscription agreement for the registered capital; SAFE FDI registration certificate; and source-of-funds declarations signed by the remitter and the WFOE legal representative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Industry licensing and trade red flags arising from temperature-controlled storage of pharmaceutical products, which may involve controlled medicines, biologics, or dual-use cold-chain equipment
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business license with the full cold-chain warehousing scope; valid pharmaceutical logistics or warehousing permit; import/export license; customs registration certificate; cold-chain temperature monitoring certification and quarantine inspection certificates; detailed product and counterparty lists; storage service contracts; and a third-party sanctions-screening report confirming no blocked parties or restricted final destinations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-residency, CRS, and FATCA classification inconsistencies for a China-resident WFOE controlled by a foreign shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: China Unified Social Credit Code certificate; company articles of association; tax registration certificate and recent corporate income tax returns; CRS self-certification and FATCA Form W-8BEN-E; written place-of-effective-management explanation; payroll and office lease records proving substantive business operations; CPA-issued capital verification report; and signed declarations on tax residence for all members of the ownership chain.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The overseas parent initiates an MT103 SWIFT wire to the WFOE's Capital Account Foreign Exchange Settlement Account at the selected tier-1 domestic bank. The remittance instruction must quote the SAFE FDI Business Registration Code, the WFOE's unified social credit code, and the appropriate SAFE balance-of-payments disclosure purpose code for direct-investment equity capital injection. No fintech pass-through account may be used. Upon receipt, the bank verifies source-of-funds documentation against the board resolution, records the receipt in the SAFE digital monitoring system, and issues an FDI payment confirmation notice. The WFOE then instructs conversion to RMB only after submitting a positive-list self-compliance declaration and paying applicable stamp tax on capital contribution. A certified Chinese CPA must issue a capital verification report within the statutory filing period, and the bank files the complete transaction set with SAFE to maintain the WFOE's foreign currency registration.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operational current-account payments, use domestic-bank cross-border RMB clearing through CIPS or SWIFT MT103 with supporting invoices, contracts, customs declarations, and tax payment certificates. For capital equipment and major cold-storage construction disbursements exceeding the bank's standard threshold, a Commercial Letter of Credit, either sight or usance, is the preferred secured clearing rail. For smaller but recurring refrigerant, spare-parts, and packaging purchases, Documentary Collections using D/P or D/A terms present shipping documents directly through the remitting bank. All outbound disbursements must be matched against the registered business scope, reported under SAFE current-account monitoring, and supported by an accurate statement of payment purpose; under-invoicing or over-invoicing is treated as FX-related trade fraud and will trigger immediate AML escalation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable RMB forward contracts with a licensed domestic designated bank, supported by genuine current-account or capital-account exposure documentation at each rollover.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps converting hard-currency debt into RMB for registered onshore foreign debt, subject to SAFE registration and permitted use of the settled RMB funds.
Short-term FX swaps for temporary working-capital mismatches, limited to genuine receipts and payments and prohibited for speculative asset-management purposes.
Offshore non-deliverable forwards are not permitted as a settlement or hedging rail for the China-domiciled WFOE; only SAFE-recognised onshore deliverable forwards are compliant hedging instruments.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Information Publicity Report (Annual Report) of the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of each year covering the immediately preceding calendar year; no anniversary-based extension.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If not published by June 30, SAMR lists the WFOE in the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations and records a late-filing penalty of up to RMB 10,000 (approx. USD 1,400). Continued non-publication for more than three years triggers removal from the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and administrative strike-off/deregistration of the WFOE.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement and Reconciliation Return (Annual CIT Filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the local in-charge tax authority's electronic tax filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 immediately following the calendar tax year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing is subject to a statutory penalty of RMB 200 to RMB 10,000, plus daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on the unpaid tax amount from the day the tax is overdue. Persistent non-filing triggers compulsory collection, blocking of e-invoice quotas, freezing of the legal representative's exit and credit records, and obstacles to deregistration; administrative strike-off is not a direct tax remedy but follows prolonged abandonment of annual publicity filings with SAMR.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Information Annual Report (Foreign Invested Enterprise Annual Information Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through SAMR's integrated National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System with data sharing to the Foreign Investment Information Reporting System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of each year reporting information as at the end of the prior calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: For failure to file or false filing, MOFCOM or SAMR will order rectification; if the enterprise refuses after the rectification deadline, a fine of RMB 100,000 to RMB 500,000 (approx. USD 14,000 to USD 70,000) may be imposed and the violation is recorded in the enterprise credit file, potentially leading to abnormal listing and barriers to administrative deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Annual Frozen/Refrigerated Warehouse Operation and Drug Cold-Chain Compliance Self-Certification Filing (applicable to ISIC 5210 / NAICS 493120 cold-storage scope)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Municipal Market Regulation Bureau and, for pharmaceutical temperature-controlled storage, the local National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) counterpart
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before March 31 of each year, or within the validity window of the enterprise's drug logistics/GSP certificate, whichever is earlier.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or continued operation without a valid temperature-controlled warehousing certificate may trigger suspension of cold-storage operations, confiscation of non-compliant stored goods, fines under the Drug Administration Law or Food Safety Law of up to RMB 1,000,000 (approx. USD 140,000), license suspension, and in repeated cases cancellation of the statutory warehouse permit.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A WFOE in mainland China is mandatorily subject to an independent annual audit by a PRC-licensed CPA firm under the Foreign Investment Law, the Accounting Law, and the annual report rules of SAMR; there is no revenue, balance-sheet, or headcount exemption for a foreign-invested entity. For reference, mandatory audit triggers for resident enterprises generally arise when: (1) total assets exceed RMB 30 million (approx. USD 4.2 million); (2) annual operating revenue exceeds RMB 30 million; (3) headcount exceeds 300; (4) the enterprise is listed, financial, insurance, public-interest, or prepares consolidated financial statements; (5) the enterprise applies for tax incentives, enters liquidation, engages in merger/acquisition, or is required by a tax or SAMR inspection to produce audited financials. A WFOE can never classify itself as a non-audited small business for annual publicity purposes.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS/ASBE) issued by the Ministry of Finance, substantially converged with IFRS; the simpler Standards for Small Enterprises route is not available to a WFOE engaged in commercial warehousing and is available only to qualifying domestic small enterprises below the specified thresholds.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under PRC Company Law, the registered shareholder register is conclusive evidence of membership; any shareholding transfer must be recorded in the register of members and an amended registration must be filed with SAMR within 30 days of the transfer. The annual SAMR report (due June 30) requires confirmation of current shareholders, ultimate controllers, and equity percentages, which operates as the annual UBO confirmation. There is no separate public UBO register in mainland China, but the WFOE must maintain internal UBO information for banks and regulators and update it within any 30-day change window in connection with equity transfer or AML renewal.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard 25% CIT rate; reduced 15% rate available for qualifying Advanced and New Technology Enterprises; small low-profit enterprises with annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million may enjoy an effective 5% rate; no patent box or logistics-specific CIT holiday in mainland China; cold-chain warehousing may benefit from VAT modern-service policies but not from corporate income tax exemptions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return Form A (A类企业所得税年度纳税申报表) filed electronically through the Electronic Tax Portal of the State Taxation Administration (e-Tax@China); quarterly prepayment via Form A on the same portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual settlement with quarterly provisional prepayments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly prepayment returns are due within 15 days after the end of each calendar quarter; the annual CIT return and final settlement for the financial year ending December 31 must be filed on or before May 31 of the following calendar year; fiscal-year entities must file within five months after the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 / Unaudited revenue line (营业收入)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue from refrigerated warehousing, cold-chain service fees, access charges, and ancillary value-added services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report global revenue to the WFOE under Chinese GAAP; exclude outbound-related revenue where the WFOE is not the service beneficiary; ensure related-party service fees are benchmarked to arm’s length under China’s transfer-pricing rules and disclose on related-party transaction schedule SF-1.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs of providing cold storage, including electricity, maintenance, labor, depreciation, and consumables.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apportion costs fairly between royalty-bearing and non-royalty-bearing streams; if the foreign parent charges a management fee, verify fee is payable under a written contract, actual services are rendered, and the fee is not a disguised dividend; disallowance applies if substance is lacking.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 / Taxes and surcharges (税金及附加)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible business taxes other than CIT, such as urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, and property-related taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withholding taxes on outbound dividends, interest, or royalties cannot be deducted as an expense on the WFOE return; VAT collected from customers is not included in revenue and is not an expense in this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 / Selling, general and administrative expenses (销售费用、管理费用、财务费用)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Indirect operating expenses, administrative salaries, rent, insurance, professional fees, forex losses, and interest expense.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to non-resident shareholders is subject to thin-capitalization rules: if debt/equity ratio exceeds 2:1 for a financial institution or 1:1 for an ordinary WFOE, excess interest is non-deductible; royalty payments must pass the beneficial-ownership test and be matched with local economic substance in the cold-chain operation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Derived after deducting Boxes 1-4 from Box 1 and adding other operational items.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure transfer-pricing adjustments, if any, are reflected here; if the CN_WFOE lacks principal risk and control, the tax authority may reallocate profit to the foreign principal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 / Non-operating income and expenses (营业外收入与营业外支出)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gains/losses from asset disposals, insurance claims, fines, donations, and government subsidies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Government subsidies related to energy-saving cold storage are taxable unless covered by specific tax circular; fines for tax violations are non-deductible.
Reconcile to local statutory financial statements; any adjustment to related-party transactions must be aligned with the shareholder agreement and OECD transfer-pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back of non-deductible expenses and out-of-limit deductions; deduct exemption and discontinued revenue items.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: High-risk adjustment: royalties paid to a parent with no actual activity in China may be treated as a dividend and become non-deductible; failure to obtain a valid withholding certificate will trigger penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 / Tax loss carryforward (弥补以前年度亏损)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount of prior-year tax losses used to offset current-year taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses of the WFOE cannot be off-set against profits of a foreign branch or parent; unused losses expire after five years unless an extended period applies for qualifying high-tech enterprises.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 10 / Taxable income (应纳税所得额)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable base after all adjustments and carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE is deemed to have a permanent establishment risk in another jurisdiction, China may tax worldwide income; ensure treaty tie-breaker rules and place-of-effective-management facts are documented.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 25% standard rate, or 15% if qualifying as encouraged high-tech enterprise.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must not apply the reduced rate unless holding a valid high-tech enterprise certificate; improper use triggers additional tax and interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 12 / CIT payable (应纳所得税额)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: After computing, subtract quarterly prepayments and any foreign tax credits for income sourced abroad; no credit is allowed for Chinese withholding tax on the WFOE’s own outbound payments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 13 / Net CIT settlement (应补退税额)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Difference between annual CIT payable and quarterly prepayments already paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Underpayment brings daily surcharge of 0.05% from the statutory filing deadline; overpayment can be refunded or carried forward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 14 / Non-resident withholding declarations (代扣代缴企业所得税申报)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Memorandum and related schedules for dividend distributions, interest payments, and royalty remittances made to non-resident enterprises.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE acts as statutory withholding agent: file Form F (扣缴企业所得税报告表) for each payment, withhold 10% unless a reduced DTA rate is approved, report on the national integrated tax portal, and obtain a withholding certificate before remitting foreign currency.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 15 / Related-party transaction disclosure (关联业务往来报告表)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Schedule of intercompany transactions with foreign parent and affiliates, including amounts, pricing methods, and counterparty tax residence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory on annual CIT return; failure to file, false filing, or omitting related-party loans/services invites 200,001-100,000 RMB fines? A more precise range: between RMB 5,000 and 20,000 per violation? The tax authority may also impose a penalty of up to 50% of the tax underpaid after TP adjustment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual CIT return attracts a fine of up to RMB 2,000 for ordinary cases and RMB 2,000-10,000 for aggravated cases; for non-resident withholding returns, late filing fines follow the same scale. Late payment interest is 0.05% per day multiplied by the underpaid tax. Where an enterprise evades CIT by understating cold-storage revenue, fabricating expenses, or concealing outbound payments, the tax authority will recover the underpaid tax, impose a monetary penalty ranging from 50% to five times the tax evaded, and pursue criminal liability under Article 203 of the Criminal Law of China if the evaded tax exceeds RMB 50,000 and is more than 10% of the total tax payable, with imprisonment up to seven years for particularly large amounts. Serious tax violations are published by the State Taxation Administration on the tax dishonesty blacklist, resulting in restrictions on credit, exit and travel, bank financing, and public procurement.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding income tax on dividends distributed by a Chinese-resident WFOE to a non-resident enterprise shareholder that has no permanent establishment in China; treaty-eligible shareholders may lower the rate to 5% where the beneficial owner holds at least 25% of the WFOE’s capital, subject to the applicable DTA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced DTA dividend withholding rate, the foreign parent must (i) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its home tax authority covering the fiscal year of the distribution, (ii) provide the TRC to the WFOE before the remittance date, (iii) submit a written beneficial-ownership self-certification with details of substantive business activity, board minutes, staffing, and bank accounts, (iv) execute China’s tax treaty benefit application form (Form 501), (v) present evidence that the dividend recipient is the actual owner and not a conduit, and (vi) retain all documentation for at least ten years. The WFOE must file the withholding return with the tax authority using the reduced rate only after the treaty relief is approved; if approval is pending, the full 10% must be withheld and a refund applied for later.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on cross-border royalties is 10% on the gross amount, plus 6% VAT on the royalty service, with a typical treaty rate of 6% under many Chinese DTAs; statutory withholding on interest is 10%, with typical treaty rates of 7% or 10% depending on the DTA and ownership structure; both require the recipient to be the beneficial owner and the transaction to have genuine commercial substance, otherwise the payment may be re-characterized as a dividend.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory if in the prior fiscal year the related-party transactions of the WFOE meet any of the following thresholds: RMB 20 million? Careful: official threshold for goods is RMB 200 million; RMB 100 million for other tangible assets, intangible assets, and financial asset transfers; RMB 40 million for intercompany services; Master File must be prepared when the aggregate related-party transaction amount exceeds RMB 1 billion; Country-by-Country Report threshold applies when the group’s consolidated revenue is at least RMB 5.5 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations like the UAE, but the General Anti-Avoidance Rule (GAAR) in China’s CIT Law Article 47 empowers the tax authority to recharacterize transactions lacking commercial rationale. The WFOE must demonstrate real economic substance through owned or leased temperature-controlled warehouse facilities, employed human resources, decision-making personnel, and independent risk control for cold-chain operations. The core income-generating activities (CIGA) include logistics planning, refrigeration monitoring, inventory custody, goods-handling services, and final customer invoicing; if those CIGA are carried out abroad or by the parent, the Chinese tax authority may reattribute profits to the parent and deny treaty benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion through false revenue and expense reporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE underpays corporate income tax by issuing false invoices for cold-storage services, under-reporting cash and direct ACH/Bank Wire payments, inflating electricity and labor costs, or recording phantom losses through related-party management fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Tax Collection Administration Law of China Articles 63 and 64, the tax authority recovers the underpaid tax and imposes a penalty of 50% to five times the amount evaded; Article 203 of the Criminal Law of China punishes tax evasion with criminal fines and imprisonment of up to seven years for large amounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: If the director or beneficial owner personally directed the evasion, signed false financial statements, or utilized the WFOE legal form to conceal assets, a recourse court may pierce the corporate veil under China’s Company Law, imposing joint and several civil liability over the director’s personal assets. The offender is placed on the tax dishonesty blacklist, subject to a travel ban, restriction on exiting or entering China, prohibition from serving as a director of other enterprises, and criminal imprisonment where the fraudulent amount exceeds the criminal threshold.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Abuse of the corporate form with no economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE is established as a shell company: no real warehouse, no employees, no bank account activity in China, passive income from subcontracting all cold-storage operations to an unrelated third party, while transferring profits abroad through excessive royalty or management fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under China’s GAAR (CIT Law Article 47) and Implementation Rules, the tax authority may disregard the entity, adjust its taxable income, deny the claimed fee deductions, levy a penalty of up to 50% of the adjusted tax deficiency, and impose interest; if the arrangement is deemed to violate the DTA anti-abuse limitations, the reduced withholding rate is revoked.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shareholders who knowingly exploited the WFOE’s separate legal personality to evade tax or external creditors may have the corporate veil pierced, making them personally liable to the tax authority for the full amount of tax, penalties, and interest. Courts may issue a travel restriction order, freeze personal bank accounts, and blacklist the director; criminal liability for fraud or tax evasion can result in up to seven years’ imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False treaty relief and disguised profit repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE submits a fraudulent Tax Residency Certificate or beneficial-ownership declaration to obtain a reduced DTA withholding rate on a dividend/interest/royalty payment that is in substance a dividend to a non-resident shareholder, or fails to withhold and pay the statutory 10% WHT on outbound remittances.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Tax Collection Administration Law and China’s Implementation Measures for Tax Treaty Benefits, the tax authority disallows the treaty benefit, recovers the underpaid withholding tax, imposes a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day and a monetary penalty of up to five times the tax evaded; false documentation may also be referred for criminal prosecution under the Criminal Law for forging official documents.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director who signed the false TRC/beneficial-ownership form or ordered the filing of a false withholding return is personally liable for restitution of the unpaid tax. A criminal conviction for tax fraud or document forgery can lead to imprisonment for up to three years for forgery and up to seven years for tax evasion. The director’s personal assets may be frozen, he or she is blacklisted as a dishonest person subject to high-consumption restrictions, denied exit visas and border privileges, and barred from corporate management offices.
